name: @ortho-earth/japan
description: Serverless, dependency-free 3D globe of Japan for any web page — GSI vector tiles and MLIT PLATEAU buildings drawn on a true sphere with WebGPU/WebGL2. No API keys, no billing, no servers.
author: Kenji Yoshida <kenji.yoshida.home.2026@gmail.com>

scripts.build:prod: npm run build:lib && vite build && cp -R dist/lib dist/site/japan/lib
scripts.deploy: npm run verify:editor && npm run verify:prod && rm -rf dist/site/japan/moj-local dist/site/japan/plateau-names.json && find dist/site -name .DS_Store -delete && wrangler deploy && node scripts/verify-live.mjs
scripts.preview:prod: npm run build:prod && rm -rf dist/site/japan/moj-local && wrangler dev
scripts.prepack: npm run build:lib && cp sdk/ortho-japan.d.ts dist/lib/ && node scripts/stage-npm-assets.mjs
